subject: Re: BriskWare POC activation cadence & owner map
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@briskware.com>, Andre Dupont <andre.dupont@briskware.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-04T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: BriskWare POC kickoff recap + proposed activation cadence

Sarah / Andre — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed plan to keep momentum: 

1) Success criteria (agreed on call) — please confirm: 
   - Reduce false-positive rate on entity extraction from ~22% to <=10% on your QA set (metric: weighted FPR)
   - Average inference latency under 220ms p50 for 1k requests/day workload
   - Integrate with your ingestion pipeline and run 3 end-to-end tests (ingest -> inference -> post-process)

2) Proposed POC activation cadence (3 weeks):
   - Week 0 (this week): procurement & data access; share sample slices (5k rows) + network allowlist
   - Week 1: technical onboarding + baseline run (Laura will lead the SE deep-dive)
   - Week 2: evaluation run and acceptance metrics review (Marissa will run post-run analysis)

3) Owners (initial):
   - Sales / commercial: Jordan Blake (schedule, SOW/contract)
   - Trials / success: Marissa Cole (onboarding, run coordination)
   - Solutions engineering: Laura Bennett (technical onboarding, test harness)

4) Ask list for BriskWare:
   - Share 5k-row anonymized sample export (CSV) and a representative schema
   - Procurement form filled (we attached a blank) and PO timeline
   - Firewall IPs to allow: we will send our list once procurement is confirmed

Attachments: BriskWare_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx (success metrics template), SOW-draft-briskware-v1.pdf (commercial draft)

Next steps: If the owners above look right, I can arrange the kickoff call for next Tue (2027-09-07) and Laura will send a short onboarding agenda. Please reply with any edits to the success criteria by EOD Friday.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
From: Sarah Liao <sarah.liao@briskware.com>

Date: 2027-09-06T14:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BriskWare POC kickoff recap + proposed activation cadence

Jordan — thanks for the clear plan and owners. A couple quick notes after sync with our data team: 

- Success criteria tweak: can we change the FP threshold to <=12% (vs your 10%) for the first evaluation run? We want to measure improvement against our current baseline and then tighten post-run.
- Procurement: attaching the procurement form filled partially; our finance lead will complete and return by next Wed. (Attachment: BriskWare_Procurement_Form.pdf)
- Onboarding slot: Tue 2027-09-07 morning works for a short kickoff (9:30–10:00 PT). Can you confirm Laura?

Also looping in procurement@briskware.com for visibility. We'll need the final SOW for internal sign-off.

—Sarah

Subject: FW: BriskWare POC kickoff recap + proposed activation cadence — internal plan

Forwarding Sarah's procurement update. Internal plan and checklist to get ready for the 9/7 kickoff (moving to 9/7 confirmed, but note procurement may push start by a few days):

- Laura: prep a 20–30 minute technical onboarding deck + runbook. Include the test harness commands and expected input/output examples.
- Jordan: finalize the SOW PDF with negotiated FP threshold set to 12% for first run and attach the signature block. Move SOW to Sales Drive under the deal folder.
- Marissa (me): create the evaluation rubric in the attached spreadsheet (I've started a tab in BriskWare_POC_SuccessCriteria.xlsx) and schedule weekly 30-min standups (Tuesdays 10am PT).

Checklist (pre-kickoff):
- [ ] BriskWare sample data received (5k rows)
- [ ] Procurement form completed and finance timeline confirmed
- [ ] Network allowlist info provided by BriskWare
- [ ] SOW final draft uploaded to HubSpot/GDrive

Note: Ben — can you provide the standard billing lead time (expected invoice to PO turnaround) so we can set realistic dates?
